mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 41 degrees at City Hall under a first quarter moon. If you are looking to the stars, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 6:27 AM, rising in the west over Mount Horeb and tracking toward the northeast near Home Depot in Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

In city news, the Verona Police arrested a school bus driver on Thursday after a report of dangerous driving; no injuries were reported. Additionally, the city has updated its zoning and sign ordinance and reminds residents to verify their assigned polling location before heading to the polls.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, join a yoga session at Insight Wellness. Looking further ahead, mark your calendars for trivia nights starting Monday at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Regarding the police report from Thursday, officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace; alcohol was ruled out as a factor and the investigation into a possible traffic sign collision continues.
Today's flavor is Mint Cookie. The store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
